deceptivePatterns.name: Hidden Reject Button
deceptivePatterns.description: Reject button is hidden, hard to find, or requires additional clicks to access

deceptivePatterns.name: Accept Button Prominence
deceptivePatterns.description: Accept button is significantly more prominent than reject button through color, size, or position

deceptivePatterns.name: Pre-checked Consent Boxes
deceptivePatterns.description: Consent options are pre-selected, violating explicit consent requirements

deceptivePatterns.name: Forced Consent
deceptivePatterns.description: No reject option available, forcing users to accept tracking

deceptivePatterns.name: Confusing Language
deceptivePatterns.description: Deliberately unclear or misleading language about data collection

deceptivePatterns.name: Obstacle Pattern
deceptivePatterns.description: Rejecting consent requires significantly more effort than accepting
